# Assault size shifts

Used in [Combat](/rules/60-combat).

## Table

| Larger | Smaller | Shift |
|---|---|---|
| division | brigade-3 | 1 |
| division | brigade-2 | 2 |
| division | battalion | 4 |
| division | company | 8 |
| brigade-3 | brigade-2 | 0 |
| brigade | battalion | 2 |
| brigade | company | 4 |
| battalion | company | 2 |

## Notes

- Cross-checked against the chart sheet (archive.org jp2 95 and scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p1): the chart lists the pairings by stacking points (5 / 3 / 2 or 3 / 1 / 0 SP) and has one row the rules text does not spell out, 3 SP vs 2 SP = no shift, added here as shift 0; the other seven rows agree
- Shift is always in favour of the side whose largest unit equivalent (SPI 9.2) is bigger
- Applies in addition to the two-column shift for double raw strength (SPI 15.51) and is independent of the basic differential
- A brigade counts as attached to a division only if its HQ counter is attached (SPI 15.55)
- E-006: the printed table misplaces the word Brigade under Adjustment; read as 3-point / 2-point brigade in the smaller-side column (Sept 1979 errata to 15.53)
